groups.saying_opens: أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم اشترى طعاما من يهودي

notes: Two sayings from one head: Ibrahim's ruling on the pledge (saying 1) and the Prophet's purchase, pledged with his armour (saying 2), each with its own route (rule 4a).
«ذكرنا عند إبراهيم» gives a place (rule 6); Ibrahim speaks («فقال لا بأس به») so he is the last link of saying 1. «أبي» is the father, a bare relation.
